findings.title: keyboard boundary fallback
findings.evidence: The fallback manually wraps after an unprevented Tab and unchanged boundary index; a handler that refocuses the last button without preventDefault is accepted. The retained isolated probe reproduced the trap three times.

findings.title: pseudo opacity
findings.evidence: Pseudo opacity is checked only for zero; sample() receives no fractional pseudo alpha. The retained black border at .01/.1 opacity reports21:1.

findings.title: SVG graphics inventory
findings.evidence: The selector accepts path/polygon/circle/rect only. A passing rectangle masks an unmeasured low-contrast ellipse/line/polyline/use.

findings.title: zero-width stroke
findings.evidence: Sampling fill/stroke opacity never tests stroke-width. A fill:none, stroke:black, stroke-width:0 rectangle is reported as meaningful21:1 icon paint.

findings.title: filter and blend paint
findings.evidence: background() rejects background images and fractional group opacity but not filters/blending. brightness(0) can make white text black-on-black while its computed color still reports21:1.

findings.title: effective glyph fill
findings.evidence: Text nodes use textCss.color without the effective -webkit-text-fill-color. White glyph fill over white with color:black is falsely measured as21:1.

findings.title: nonancestor background layers
findings.evidence: background() composites ancestors only. An opaque black positioned sibling underneath black glyphs is absent from the reported white background.

findings.title: ancestor opacity in geometry
findings.evidence: focusGeometry skips a visual whose own opacity is0 but does not reject opacity0 ancestry; its contour can be reported visible in an invisible group.

findings.title: descendant obstruction
findings.evidence: related() exempts every descendant through contains(element,candidate); an opaque child extending across the target and ring is skipped by occlusion measurement.

findings.title: generated text inventory
findings.evidence: The text traversal samples actual text nodes/input content, not pseudo generated text. A low-contrast ::before label disappears beside a passing paragraph.

findings.title: collapsed negative-spread shadow
findings.evidence: outerShadows discards collapsed spread only at zero offset. A10px offset with -100px spread draws no pixels yet geometry/contrast pass; retained screenshots were identical resting/focused.

findings.title: unchanged shadow layer
findings.evidence: audit.changed qualifies a changed complete shadow list; all layers, including a permanent black layer, are then sampled. Appending an invisible white layer can produce a false focus pass with identical pixels.

findings.title: inset pseudo border adjacency
findings.evidence: Pseudo border samples always pass outside=true. A black border wholly inside a black control is compared against white ancestry and reported21:1 despite identical resting/focused pixels.

findings.title: pseudo opacity
findings.evidence: Same root as BH02, independently reproduced with a black pseudo focus border at opacity.1. The pseudo alpha is never passed into sample().

findings.title: placeholder opacity
findings.evidence: Placeholder sampling reads the pseudo color but not its separate opacity; an opacity.1 black placeholder on white is reported21:1.

findings.title: SVG graphics inventory
findings.evidence: Same selector omission as BH03; independent ellipse fixture leaves only the passing rectangle in the contrast inventory.

findings.title: Settings delayed vendor return regression
findings.evidence: Pre-verified regression gap: the held actual Fluent25ms callback test opens palette only. Settings coverage ends at initial origin return; removing its vendor-return suppression has no equivalent delayed-operator-movement regression.

findings.title: pseudo opacity
findings.evidence: Independently reproduced black pseudo underline with opacity.1 passes geometry and reports21:1 rather than effective approximately1.25:1. Same root as BH02/EC04.
